title: Monitor
summary: A Datadog monitor card from its snapshot under evidence/datadog/: name, type, whether it caught, missed or was added after the incident, the query, the thresholds, the evaluation delay and no-data settings, then a strip of its alert, warning and recovery transitions against the timestamps, with how long after onset it fired computed from detection.monitors[].fired or its first alert. The page renders one per detection.monitors entry in Resolution and detection; declare one to place it elsewhere or to hide the strip.
belongs: Resolution and detection. Declared, it also fits a cause card about why a symptom went unseen.

monitor.description: the id of a detection.monitors or evidence.monitors entry

marks.description: draw the transition strip; default true
